info.description: The upstream wiki says this API is internal/private, is not intended for non-ONS web applications, may change without notice, and prevents cross-origin browser requests. This file is generated from a wiki snapshot and static source review; it is not an upstream ONS API contract.
info.title: Explore Local Statistics internal API — OKF review draft

get.description: Filter one or more indicators by topic, geography, time, dimensions and measures.

parameters.description: Path value for format.
parameters.name: format

parameters.description: One or more comma-separated topic or sub-topic codes, or all.
parameters.name: topic

parameters.description: One or more comma-separated indicator slugs, or all.
parameters.name: indicator

parameters.description: Exclude multivariate indicators unless explicitly selected.
parameters.name: excludeMultivariate

parameters.description: latest, earliest, all, one date, or a comma-separated inclusive range.
parameters.name: time

parameters.description: Fallback behaviour when the selected date is outside an indicator's range.
parameters.name: timeNearest

parameters.description: One or more comma-separated geography-level keys or GSS codes.
parameters.name: geo

parameters.description: Parent GSS code used to constrain returned geographies.
parameters.name: geoExtent

parameters.description: Statistical cluster in grouping_cluster form.
parameters.name: geoCluster

parameters.description: Return indicators that include a geography level or GSS code.
parameters.name: hasGeo

parameters.description: One or more measures. The wiki lists this parameter but does not define its semantics.
parameters.name: measure

parameters.description: Include human-readable area names where supported.
parameters.name: includeNames

parameters.description: Include observation-level status identifiers where available.
parameters.name: includeStatus

200.description: Successful response. The wiki does not provide a complete response schema.

400.description: Invalid, duplicate, unsupported or oversized request.

404.description: Requested indicator, dimension or area was not found.

measure is listed but not explained
Response and error contracts are incomplete
